author: reek
body: PCB panelization for manufacturing. Computes step-and-repeat board arrays with V-score lines, tab-route breakaway tabs, and fiducial marks. All dimensions in nanometers.

author: reek
body: Horizontal score lines between rows and vertical score lines between columns spanning the full panel array area.

author: reek
body: Three fiducial marks: bottom-left corner, bottom-right corner, and top-left corner offset slightly inward from the panel rails.
